verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships agentic products (Cortex Agents, Cortex Code), so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis. However, the pack only documents the Snowflake-managed MCP server, which exposes Snowflake tools to outside agents. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story, and no evidence shows Snowflake connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.
